species: Splicosome disassembly factors ILP1 and NTR1 promote miRNA biogenesis in Arabidopsis thaliana
tissue: Protein extracts prepared from pistils (In Our hands, endogenous DCL1 is hardly to be detected in other tissues but can be robustly detected in pistils by Western blot.) of pILP1::ILP1-GFP or p35S::GFP transgenic plants were subjected to mass spectrometry (Mass-Spec) to identify ILP1-interacting proteins and to determine interactions between ILP1 and core processing proteins (DCL1, SE and HYL1).
sample_source: Protein extracts prepared from pistils (In Our hands, endogenous DCL1 is hardly to be detected in other tissues but can be robustly detected in pistils by Western blot.) of pILP1::ILP1-GFP or p35S::GFP transgenic plants were subjected to mass spectrometry (Mass-Spec) to identify ILP1-interacting proteins and to determine interactions between ILP1 and core processing proteins (DCL1, SE and HYL1).
strain: All the plant materials used in this study were in the Columbia (Col) background except for ago4-1, which was in the Landsberg erecta-0 (Ler-0) background.
